description.zh-CN: 工程代理路径（沙箱内 Git、改代码、测试运行器、PR 接口）、默认分支禁止直接 push、受保护分支合并须人工
description.en-US: Engineering-agent path (Git, edits, test runner, and PR API inside the sandbox), no direct push to the default branch, human required to merge a protected branch

description.zh-CN: 工程痛点：绿测仍被撤回、工程师不让代理碰仓库、评审排队变长
description.en-US: Engineering pain: green tests still reverted, engineers block the agent from their repo, the review queue grows

description.zh-CN: 测试只断言旧接口所以改错行为也能绿；沙箱仍能读到生产密钥；PR 描述会回显环境变量
description.en-US: Tests only assert the old interface so wrong behavior can still go green; the sandbox can still read production secrets; the PR description echoes environment variables

description.zh-CN: 业务影响：撤回打乱发布窗口、密钥进 PR 就要轮换、工程经理想先清积压而平台安全要先锁权限
description.en-US: Business impact: a revert scrambles the release window, a secret in a PR forces rotation, the eng manager wants the backlog cleared first while platform security wants permissions locked first

description.zh-CN: 实施限制：受保护分支合并与生产密钥使用须人工、禁止 push 默认分支，生产密钥不得进入沙箱或 PR
description.en-US: Implementation constraints: human required for protected-branch merges and production-secret use, no push to the default branch, production secrets must not enter the sandbox or a PR

description.zh-CN: 成功指标：沙箱内修 Bug、跑测试、开 PR 成为默认路径；绿测不得掩盖行为回归；PR 中不得出现秘密
description.en-US: Success metrics: sandbox bug-fix, test, and PR as the default path; green tests must not hide a behavior regression; a secret must not appear in a PR

description.zh-CN: 信任问题：IC 绕过代理手写补丁，工程经理把绿测当成合并许可，QA 低估行为回归
description.en-US: Trust issues: the IC bypasses the agent with hand-written patches; the eng manager treats green tests as merge permission; QA underestimates behavior regressions

description.zh-CN: 失败模式：测试已绿但行为被改错；秘密被写进 PR 描述
description.en-US: Failure modes: tests green on the wrong behavior; a secret written into a PR description

label.zh-CN: 工程代理问题陈述清晰度

description.zh-CN: 能否准确描述需要沙箱内修 Bug、跑测试、开 PR 的工程代理，而不是让代理直接碰默认分支
description.en-US: Can accurately describe why the team needs a sandbox agent that fixes bugs, runs tests, and opens PRs, not an agent that touches the default branch

description.zh-CN: 是否识别了工程经理、平台安全、一线开发和质量负责人及其核心关切
description.en-US: Has identified the eng manager, platform security, IC developer, and QA lead with their core concerns

description.zh-CN: 是否明确定义了可衡量的成功指标（沙箱默认路径、绿测不得掩盖回归、PR 中不得出现秘密）
description.en-US: Are measurable success criteria (sandbox default path, green tests must not hide regressions, no secrets in a PR) clearly defined

description.zh-CN: 方案是否覆盖 Git/沙箱/测试/PR 接口、受保护分支与密钥 HITL、绿测掩盖回归与秘密进 PR 的处理
description.en-US: Does the solution cover Git/sandbox/tests/PR API, HITL on protected branches and secrets, and handling of green-on-wrong-behavior plus secrets in a PR

label.zh-CN: 沙箱代理与人工改仓的权衡
label.en-US: Sandbox Agent vs. Human-only Edit Trade-off

description.zh-CN: 方案是否清晰地权衡了隔离沙箱里的工程代理与只允许人改仓库
description.en-US: Does the solution clearly weigh a sandbox engineering agent against human-only repo edits

label.zh-CN: 密钥与 HITL 兼容性

description.zh-CN: 方案是否在受保护分支合并、生产密钥使用必须人工、禁止 push 默认分支的限制内可行
description.en-US: Is the solution feasible within HITL on protected-branch merges and production secrets, and no push to the default branch

label.zh-CN: 绿测错行为与秘密进 PR 应对

description.zh-CN: 能否有效应对测试已绿但行为被改错、以及秘密写进 PR 等不安全自动化
description.en-US: Can effectively address unsafe automation such as green tests on the wrong behavior and a secret written into a PR

label.zh-CN: 受保护分支与密钥升级应对

description.zh-CN: 是否建立了受保护分支合并与生产密钥使用必须人工、默认分支不得被直接 push 的升级通道
description.en-US: Has a reliable path been established so protected-branch merges and production-secret use wait for a human, and the default branch cannot be pushed

description.zh-CN: 是否面向工程经理的清积压压力与平台安全的密钥关切进行阐述，同时承认 HITL 会限制全自动合并
description.en-US: Does the presentation address the eng manager's backlog pressure and platform security's secret concerns while acknowledging HITL limits fully automatic merges

description.zh-CN: 方案表达是否清晰、有说服力、行动导向
description.en-US: Is the presentation clear, persuasive, and action-oriented

description.zh-CN: 分阶段工程代理上线（先沙箱只读检查与开 PR，再 HITL 合并）是否合理、可实现
description.en-US: Is the phased engineering-agent rollout (sandbox read checks and opening PRs first, then HITL merges) reasonable and achievable

description.zh-CN: 绿测质量、秘密泄漏与发布窗口的度量体系是否明确
description.en-US: Are green-test quality, secret-leak, and release-window metrics clearly defined

description.zh-CN: 是否识别了绿测掩盖回归、秘密进 PR、直接 push 默认分支和 IC 绕过等风险并制定了缓解计划
description.en-US: Are risks such as green tests hiding regressions, secrets in a PR, pushing the default branch, and IC bypass identified with mitigation plans

statement.zh-CN: 工程经理想用代理清 Bug 积压并在测试绿后合并，而平台安全要求受保护分支合并与生产密钥使用必须人工
statement.en-US: The eng manager wants the agent to clear the bug backlog and merge after green tests, while platform security requires a human for protected-branch merges and production-secret use

statement.zh-CN: 工程经理把绿测当成合并许可，而 IC 不让代理碰仓库、QA 担心测试只锁旧接口
statement.en-US: The eng manager treats green tests as merge permission, while the IC will not let the agent touch the repo and QA fears tests only lock the old interface

1.zh-CN: 在谈编码代理之前，改动现在是按什么顺序从仓库走到评审的？
1.en-US: Before proposing the coding agent, in what order does a change currently move from the repo to review?

2.zh-CN: 去找 Git、沙箱、测试和开 PR 的顺序，以及默认分支和受保护分支怎么被守住。
2.en-US: Look for the order of Git, sandbox, tests, and opening a PR, and how the default and protected branches are held.

3.zh-CN: 代理修 Bug 时会按什么顺序用 Git、沙箱、测试运行器和 PR 接口？默认分支和受保护分支现在分别怎么处理？
3.en-US: When the agent fixes a bug, in what order does it use Git, the sandbox, the test runner, and the PR API? How are the default branch and protected branches handled today?

1.zh-CN: 编码代理现在最疼的是返工、评审负担，还是仓库信任？
1.en-US: Is the coding agent hurting most on rework, review load, or repo trust?

2.zh-CN: 去找绿测仍被撤回的情况、工程师是否放手，以及评审排队。
2.en-US: Look for green tests that still get reverted, whether engineers let go of the repo, and the review queue.

3.zh-CN: 测试已经绿的 PR 后来有多少会被撤回？工程师愿不愿意让代理动自己的仓库？
3.en-US: How often do already-green PRs still get reverted later, and are engineers willing to let the agent touch their repo?

1.zh-CN: 现有代理卡住的是测试有效性、密钥边界，还是仓库权限？
1.en-US: Is the current agent stuck on test effectiveness, secret boundaries, or repo permissions?

2.zh-CN: 去找测试断言覆盖的是什么、沙箱能读到什么、PR 文本会回显什么。
2.en-US: Look for what test assertions actually cover, what the sandbox can read, and what PR text echoes.

3.zh-CN: 现有测试实际锁住的是接口还是行为？沙箱里能碰到哪些密钥？开 PR 时描述里会出现什么？
3.en-US: Do current tests actually lock the interface or the behavior, what secrets can the sandbox reach, and what shows up in the description when a PR is opened?

1.zh-CN: 合错变更和密钥进评审，分别打在发布还是安全响应上？
1.en-US: Do a bad merge and a secret in review hit the release, the security response, or both?

2.zh-CN: 去找撤回对发布窗口的影响，以及密钥一旦进 PR 要做什么。
2.en-US: Look for how a revert hits the release window and what must happen if a secret enters a PR.

3.zh-CN: 一次撤回会怎样打乱发布？密钥如果出现在 PR 里，安全要怎么收场？工程经理还想先用代理清积压吗？
3.en-US: How does one revert scramble the release, what must security do if a secret appears in a PR, and does the eng manager still want the agent to clear the backlog first?

1.zh-CN: 合并、密钥和默认分支，分别被什么拦住？
1.en-US: What stops a merge versus secret use versus a push to the default branch?

2.zh-CN: 去找必须人工的合并与密钥使用，以及默认分支能不能被直接 push。
2.en-US: Look for merges and secret uses that require a human, and whether the default branch can be pushed directly.

3.zh-CN: 受保护分支合并和生产密钥使用要不要人工？默认分支能不能被直接 push？生产密钥能不能进沙箱或 PR？
3.en-US: Must protected-branch merges and production-secret use wait for a human, may the default branch be pushed directly, and may production secrets enter the sandbox or a PR?

1.zh-CN: 管理层用清 Bug 速度、回归质量还是密钥干净来宣布编码代理成功？
1.en-US: Will leadership call this coding agent a win on bug-clearing speed, regression quality, or clean secrets?

2.zh-CN: 去找沙箱修 Bug 是否成为默认路径，以及绿测和行为、PR 文本里的秘密这类红线。
2.en-US: Look for whether sandbox bug-fixes are the default path, and the floors around green tests versus behavior and secrets in PR text.

3.zh-CN: 怎样才算修 Bug、跑测试、开 PR 成为默认路径？绿测能不能代替行为确认？PR 里能不能出现秘密？
3.en-US: What would make fix-test-and-open-PR the default path, may a green test replace behavior confirmation, and may a secret appear in a PR?

1.zh-CN: IC、经理和 QA 对同一套编码代理，分别怕什么、盼什么？
1.en-US: What do the IC, the manager, and QA fear or expect from the same coding agent?

2.zh-CN: 去找 IC 是否绕过代理手写补丁，以及经理对绿测即可合并的预期。
2.en-US: Look for IC workarounds that bypass the agent with hand-written patches and the manager's expectation that green tests mean merge.

3.zh-CN: IC 会不会不让代理碰自己的仓库？经理和 QA 对绿测与行为回归分别怎么看？
3.en-US: Will the IC refuse to let the agent touch their repo, and how do the manager and QA each view green tests versus behavior regressions?

1.zh-CN: 流水线看起来都过了，和敏感东西离开沙箱，哪种更可能把编码代理打穿？
1.en-US: Which failure punches through first: a pipeline that looks fine, or something sensitive leaving the sandbox?

2.zh-CN: 去找绿测实际锁住的是什么，以及评审文本能带上什么。
2.en-US: Look for what a green test actually locks, and what review text can carry.

3.zh-CN: 测试已经绿的时候，还需要确认什么？开 PR 时描述里会带上什么？
3.en-US: When tests are already green, what still needs confirming? What can a PR description carry when it is opened?

description.zh-CN: 在SOLUTION阶段，学员必须展示一个包含 Git/沙箱/测试/PR 接口、受保护分支与密钥 HITL、以及绿测错行为与秘密进 PR 处理的完整方案
description.en-US: In the SOLUTION phase, the learner must demonstrate a complete plan with Git/sandbox/tests/PR API, HITL on protected branches and secrets, and handling of green-on-wrong-behavior plus secrets in a PR

description.zh-CN: 在PITCH阶段，学员必须面向管理层展示可量化的吞吐收益，并化解绿测掩盖回归、秘密进 PR 与 IC 绕过等安全顾虑
description.en-US: In the PITCH phase, the learner must present quantifiable throughput value to leadership and address green tests hiding regressions, secrets in a PR, and IC bypass
